zh.name: 吞神子嗣
zh.desc: 归寂分裂「贪饕」力量所生成的怪物军团，如今「幻造种」的原型。他自哈托彼亚沉睡的核心中感应到「贪饕」永不停歇的吞噬渴望，其力量的脉动与「毁灭」命途十分合拍。这份躁动令他感到有趣，因此他开始自己的黑暗创造——抹去人类的头颅，留下发笑和吞噬的嘴，永不满足地向外界咆哮、索要、吞吃。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对指定我方单体造成少量火属性伤害，并大概率使受到攻击的目标的防御力降低。
使指定我方角色陷入【吞噬】状态，可回复的生命上限降低，并夺取该角色一定比例的攻击力。
自身施加的【吞噬】状态被解除时，使解除【吞噬】状态的我方单位的攻击力提高。
对我方全体造成少量火属性伤害。
每次受到我方单位攻击后，使被自身施加【吞噬】状态的我方角色可回复的生命上限提高，并归还一定比例的攻击力。受到我方单位一定次数的攻击后、或弱点被击破时，解除自身施加的【吞噬】状态。

en.name: God-Devourer Offspring
en.desc: A monstrous legion created from Asat Pramad's split "Voracity" power, now the prototype of the "imagenae." Asat Pramad sensed within the dormant core from Ahatopia an unending hunger tied to the Voracity, whose pulsation resonated closely with the Path of Destruction. Amused by this restless force, he began his dark creation: erasing human heads, leaving only grinning, devouring mouths that howl, demand, and consume without end.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals minor Fire DMG to one designated target, with a high chance to reduce the attacked target's DEF.
Causes one designated target character to enter the "Devour" state, reducing their Maximum Restorable HP and stealing a certain percentage of the character's ATK.
When the "Devour" state applied by this unit is dispelled, increases the ATK of the target unit who has dispelled the "Devour" state.
Deals minor Fire DMG to all targets.

Each time after this unit is attacked by a target unit, increases the Maximum Restorable HP of the target character inflicted with the "Devour" state by this unit, and returns a certain percentage of ATK. After receiving a certain number of attacks from target units, or when its Weakness is Broken, dispels the "Devour" state applied by this unit.
